sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Removes resurrection, wards, invincibility, damage reflection, continuous healing, and damage reduction effects.
-Target: 1 random enemy out of all enemies. Ability Power 460. Success value 80. 10x physical damage (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Increases attack Ability accuracy by 40% for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 3 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases max HP by 100% for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies buff removal resistance, preventing karma or any buff removal effect one time.
-Target: yourself. Applies Grace for 90 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction, status ailments, and debuffs. After the effect ends, 100 Cost is restored to your character).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 10000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 10000
